note_outdated: The personad on this computer is too old to operate iPhones. Redeploy it
err_off: The phone control extension is off, or this computer can’t reach iPhones
err_consent_device: Only your own signed-in Persona app can allow an iPhone to be operated
err_no_device: Which iPhone? The request names none
manifest_description: Lets the assistant operate the iPhones paired with your computers: see the screen, tap, swipe, type and take screenshots. Pair the iPhone with that computer, and allow it in that iPhone’s Persona app.
manifest_machines_description: The assistant operates an iPhone only through a computer turned on here that is paired with it. Takes effect at once; the same as “Allow the assistant to operate iPhones through this computer” on the computer’s page
manifest_phones_description: Each iPhone adds itself here once allowed in its own Persona › Settings › Connectors › This iPhone; the assistant never operates an iPhone not listed
manifest_confirm_title: Ask on the phone before every action
manifest_confirm_description: When on, the assistant asks you before every tap, swipe and typing; when off, only sensitive actions such as paying, sending and deleting are asked
err_not_enabled: Phone control isn’t on for this computer
rpc_no_bridge: The iPhone device bridge (persona-iphone-bridge) isn’t installed on this computer
rpc_none_paired: No iPhone is paired with this computer yet. Connect it with a cable, tap Pair on the machine’s page, then tap Trust on the iPhone
rpc_usb_unpaired: Connected with a cable but not paired yet. Tap Pair on the machine’s page
rpc_failed: Something went wrong with this iPhone. Try again later
rpc_unreachable: Can’t reach this iPhone. Keep it on and on the same network as this computer
rpc_pairing_missing: This computer has no pairing record for it. Pair again with a cable
rpc_pairing_rejected: This iPhone no longer trusts this computer (it was removed or erased). Pair again with a cable
rpc_wrong_device: A different iPhone answered at this address. Wait for it to be found again, or pair again
rpc_tunnel_failed: Reached this iPhone but couldn’t set up the encrypted tunnel. Try again later, or pair again
rpc_developer_mode_off: Developer Mode is off on this iPhone. Turn it on in Settings › Privacy & Security › Developer Mode, then confirm after the restart
rpc_ddi_not_mounted: The developer disk image isn’t mounted on this iPhone. Connect it to this computer with a cable once, then try again
rpc_service_unavailable: This iPhone is missing a device service it needs, so it can’t be operated
rpc_locked: This iPhone is locked. Unlock it to operate it
rpc_unsupported: This iPhone’s iOS version doesn’t support this
rpc_disconnected: The connection to this iPhone dropped. Reconnecting
rpc_timeout: This iPhone didn’t answer in time
rpc_trust_pending: Tap Trust on the iPhone, then tap Pair again
rpc_not_found: This iPhone isn’t on the cable. Plug it in again and retry
err_no_enabled: Say whether to turn it on or off
card_need_confirm: you asked to confirm every action
card_need_unchecked: the target on the screen can't be identified
manifest_self_names_title: Persona's app name on the iPhones
